description: Cambridgeshire Hourly Automatic Traffic Counter data January 2019-December 2022 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cambridgeshire Insight. This dataset is hourly data from the Automatic Traffic Counters across Cambridgeshire from January 2019 to December 2022 where available. Check the 'time period' column on the table accompanying the linked dataset forset for details of when each sensor ceases to supply count information. The data combines vehicles/cycles going in both directions unless otherwise stated. Coverage: Cambridgeshire Insight. The portal files it under the publisher Cambridgeshire Insight. Its tags are Traffic, active travel, cycling. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-05-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
